mapper.select: SELECT feature_key as featureKey, enabled, version, updated_by_id as updatedById, updated_by_role as updatedByRole, updated_by_name as updatedByName, updated_reason as updatedReason, preset_name as presetName, updated_at as updatedAt FROM runtime_feature_toggle ORDER BY feature_key

SELECT feature_key as featureKey, enabled, version, updated_by_id as updatedById, updated_by_role as updatedByRole, updated_by_name as updatedByName, updated_reason as updatedReason, preset_name as presetName, updated_at as updatedAt FROM runtime_feature_toggle WHERE feature_key = #{featureKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runtime_feature_toggle(feature_key, enabled, version, updated_by_id, updated_by_role, updated_by_name, updated_reason, preset_name, updated_at) VALUES(#{featureKey}, #{enabled}, #{version}, #{updatedById}, #{updatedByRole}, #{updatedByName}, #{updatedReason}, #{presetName}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), version = VALUES(version), updated_by_id = VALUES(updated_by_id), updated_by_role = VALUES(updated_by_role), updated_by_name = VALUES(updated_by_name), updated_reason = VALUES(updated_reason), preset_name = VALUES(preset_name), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
